title: Kelly Clarkson disputes Brooklyn store's account of sales interaction
summary: Singer Kelly Clarkson has publicly stated that a Brooklyn toy store treated her poorly and falsely claimed an item was not for sale. The store, which reportedly sells a $15,000 animatronic singing bird, claims the item Clarkson wanted was not for sale. Clarkson described the interaction as "Pretty Woman" treatment and stated the store "just lost a huge sale," calling them "liars."
